infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: FakeLives shows your camera on screen so it looks like you are streaming. Nothing is recorded or uploaded.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: FakeLives lets you pick a profile picture from your photos.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: FakeLives listens so the fake chat can react to what you say. Nothing is recorded.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: FakeLives turns your speech into text on your phone so the fake chat can answer you.
